name: rideshare-genesis
description: RideShare Genesis V1 - a human-centred, explainable ridesharing platform

scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.build:worker-frontend: VITE_API_URL=/api VITE_WS_MODE=native npm run build --workspace frontend -- --outDir ../worker/public --emptyOutDir
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build:worker-frontend && cd worker && npm run deploy
